about: Ref-to-ref facts the WWFF-POTA cross reference (kpc_wwff_links.py) starts from. Standard JSON, read only by kpc_wwff_links.py. Nothing here is a pin or a boundary. repo_baseline = locations.json column 8 as it stood on 2026-11-14, before the link writer (frozen, so links the writer adds later are never counted back as a second source).
credit: VEFF-POTA cross reference list by VE3ZN (Aug 2025); KFF-POTA cross reference (2018)

community_kff_2018.source: KFF-POTA cross reference (2018): park numbers 0001 through 4446 (except 3791) are direct cross references (KFF-n = US-n), plus the explicit rows
